subject.title: improve(agents): exact web_fetch output contract with cleaned result shape

question: Should OpenClaw make the proposed `length` plus nested `spill` schema the sole model-facing `web_fetch` contract, removing `wrappedLength` and the flat spill fields without compatibility aliases?
rationale: This is an intentional externally consumed agent-tool result-shape decision; tests can validate implementation but cannot determine whether the retired fields remain a supported model or plugin contract.

options.title: Adopt the closed contract
options.body: Accept the canonical nested shape after real runtime proof confirms all supported fetch paths emit it consistently.

options.title: Preserve a transition contract
options.body: Keep or document a bounded compatibility path if maintainers identify supported consumers that require the retired fields during migration.

recommendation.title: Adopt the closed contract
recommendation.body: Accept the canonical nested shape after real runtime proof confirms all supported fetch paths emit it consistently.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the current contract proposal and is the only concrete routing signal available in the supplied history.
